gpu_regression: 16384 subresources: one lost initialization at zero-based slice 9294, reproduced twice; 8192 control correct

initial_environment_note: First upload and overflow runs pointed CompatDB to its source directory and logged unavailable; control/repeat used compiled/compatdb.cdb. Overlay loading and real GPU readback succeeded in all desktop runs. Initial sandbox Mach-port failures are excluded.
